jobs.meta: Tata Consultancy Services · Chennai, India · 08/2024 – Present
jobs.lede: Delivering production-grade enterprise AI solutions across GCP and AWS for supply chain document automation, multi-agent insurance claims, enterprise IT support, and apparel commerce.
highlights: Deployed a serverless GCP-based document processing pipeline to automate vendor packing slip extraction and JDE ERP integration across 20+ suppliers, projecting savings of 2,800-3,700 manual hours per distribution center annually.
Boosted extraction accuracy from 75% to 95% by transitioning to a generative AI schema framework, achieving 80% end-to-end automation across non-standard supplier templates.
Architected a LangGraph-based multi-agent insurance claims pipeline with interrupt checkpoints for human review of high-risk claims, backed by deterministic guardrails, PII masking and audit logs.
Engineered an automated CI test suite and custom evaluation engine combining full branch-coverage graph checks, hand-calibrated LLM-as-a-judge scoring, and trajectory path-conformance checks.
Developed an enterprise IT ticket triage RAG assistant for support staff, enforcing server-side pre-retrieval access control for internal SOPs and confidence-gated fallback synthesis.

Designed a hybrid BM25 + dense search and cross-encoder reranking engine, achieving 95% Recall@5 and 0.81 NDCG@5, validated via prompt-injection testing, dual-layer citation checks, and LLM-as-a-judge evals.

Led a 5-member team, delivering a Bedrock-powered Virtual Try-On feature across 21 apparel categories in a Dynamic Yield environment on AWS, driving shopper engagement with projected 2-5% conversion uplift and 10% return-rate reduction.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
